prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [反例] 交错跨列 · 共享中间列 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 4 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Merged cells: "与业务方共同梳理核心流程，输出需求说明书并完成评" spans 2 col × 1 row; "完成核心模块开发与联调，接入统一认证与日志平台" spans 2 col × 1 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "项目" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 35px
  col 2: header "阶段一" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 87px
  col 3: header "阶段二" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 53px
  col 4: header "阶段三" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 53px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 199px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 198px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"按需求、开发、测试三个项目类别展示各阶段的工作内容。","reading":"读者先沿行查看同一类别在各阶段的工作，再沿阶段列比较不同类别的安排；跨列单元格表示一项工作覆盖相邻阶段。","groups":["第2至第4列均为阶段列，承担相同的时间组织作用。","第2、3列及第3、4列分别被跨列内容连接，第3列是两项跨列内容共享的中间列。"],"keep_intact":["汉字应保持完整；项目类别和阶段标题尽可能保持在一行。"],"may_wrap":["较长的需求和开发描述可按中文自然换行。","较短的工作名称可利用同行长描述产生的行高换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [56, 47, 48, 47] · table 199×527px · row heights [92, 197, 171, 66] · column headers wrapped 3/4 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [39, 52, 52, 52] · table 196×527px · row heights [92, 197, 171, 66] · column headers wrapped 4/4 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [55, 39, 63, 39] · table 197×527px · row heights [92, 197, 171, 66] · column headers wrapped 4/4 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Constraint adjustments applied: r0B: raised a column to the minimum 40px; scaled down from 199px to fit 198px
r0C: raised a column to the minimum 40px; raised a column to the minimum 40px; scaled down from 200px to fit 198px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"项目列较宽，项目标题和需求、开发、测试类别均保持一行；三个阶段列宽度接近，阶段之间的对应关系清楚。两项跨列描述分别覆盖相近宽度，长文字的换行比较均衡。","problems":"三个阶段标题都竖向断成三行，削弱了表头的可读性；搭建脚手架等短词也被挤成很窄的文字列，开发行显得零碎。","cause":"项目列占56px，留给各阶段列的宽度只有47–48px；扣除21px边距和边框后，每列只能容纳一个汉字。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"三个阶段列等宽，时间结构清楚；两项跨列描述获得相同宽度，长文字的节奏一致。","problems":"项目标题和三个项目类别都断成两行，行的起点不够醒目；阶段标题仍断成三行，短工作名称也显得拥挤。","cause":"项目列只有39px，扣除边距和边框后仅能容纳一个汉字；每个阶段列为52px，也不足以容纳两个汉字。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"项目类别保持完整；中间阶段列较宽，使阶段二标题和回归等短内容更易辨认，同时两项跨列描述仍有相同宽度。","problems":"阶段一和阶段三标题仍各断成三行，搭建脚手架被排成单字纵列；中间列虽然较宽，阶段二标题仍需两行。","cause":"第2、4列只有39px；第3列63px扣除边距和边框后只能容纳两个汉字，尚不足以让三字阶段标题完整显示。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"完整中间阶段","widths":[40,40,78,40],"change":"将更多宽度集中到共享的阶段二列，尝试让其三字标题完整显示，并同时拓宽两项跨列描述；代价是项目类别和两侧阶段列更窄。"},{"name":"保留项目兼顾开发","widths":[55,40,55,48],"change":"保留完整的项目类别，让阶段二达到可容纳两个汉字的宽度，并把更多空间给阶段三，以改善开发跨列描述；阶段一相应收窄。"}]}
